releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.8 (Build 85):
• Blank Page Root Fix: Restored instant, reliable route rendering across all 15 interfaces, eliminating height collapse.
• Complete Water Liquid Optics: Physics-grounded specular meniscus reflection rims and volumetric dark glass depth across all cards.
• Rock-Solid Container Stability: Main cards stay firmly anchored on the canvas; interactions occur strictly inside sub-cards, buttons, and chips.
• Multi-Tier Crisp Haptic Feedback: Distinct physical profiles for selection ticks, light touches, solid medium clicks, and dual-pulse ratchet confirmations.
• 120Hz Droplet Drag Detents: Fluid navigation droplet scrubbing with tactile hardware detent ticks at every slot boundary.
• Legacy UI Migration: Modernized Calendar event sheet with unified design system and streamlined daily quotes marquee.
• Zero-Lag 120 FPS Performance: Replaced costly backdrop blur shaders with GPU-accelerated progressive OLED ambient scrims.
